integrity: All reported mathematical claims follow the supplied analytic proof with explicit dependency on published optimal-rounding theory; finite enumeration is supplementary and is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-cutoff order criterion holds for one early and one late cutoff; asymptotic density uses recursively compatible optimal one- and two-choice cutoffs. No effective density-convergence rate, no higher-choice extension, and no independent mathematical assessment. Earlier historical literature could contain an unrecognized implication.
title: Stochastic-order reversals for the successful arrival time in the two-choice secretary problem
